skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and explain fundamental concepts of data structures and algorithms, including arrays, lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs, sorting, and searching.
Design and implement algorithms for data structures and operations.
Apply algorithms to solve problems and evaluate their performance.
Write and analyze code for data structures and algorithms.
Communicate effectively about data structures and algorithms in written and oral form.
Work independently and collaboratively in group settings.
Demonstrate ethical responsibility and professional conduct in the field of information systems management.
